name: Awakening
audio: a low, rising shimmer, a soft swell of energy, then a gentle chime as the moths scatter; no speech
notes: Takes the plain Enchanted Evening render and adds the magic the still left out. Source is an art card, so the intro is summarised from what we asked for.

actions.beat: The {{MAGIC}} smoke and radiant light swirl into a ring of glowing spectral moths circling {{her}} raised hand, then spread through the moonlit balcony as the candle flames flare to match.
